conditions: A dedicated submit page exists at /submit-tool/ but the page mixes 'Submit Your Tool' with 'Showcase and Advertise with Us' — a paid advertising route is co-located and the free path's specifics are not visible (site rate-limited automated fetches)
Catalog note says freemium — consistent with a free submission plus paid showcase/advertising
requirements: AI tools only — curated directory across 87 categories
Submissions are curated ('contribute your AI tools'), not auto-published
preparation: Tool name, URL, description, category, logo/screenshots, pricing
workflow: Open https://ailisting.ai/submit-tool/ in a browser (the site returned 429 to automated fetching — space requests or use a real browser)
Optionally explore the 'Showcase and Advertise with Us' paid placements
Watch for the listing in the directory (1544+ tools, searchable on the homepage)
watchFor: Site aggressively rate-limits (HTTP 429) — automated agents should throttle or use a browser
The submit page doubles as an advertising pitch — expect a paid upsell mid-flow
Marketing copy is heavy on enthusiasm, light on concrete rules — no published eligibility or timeline
countsAsLive: The tool is searchable/browsable on ailisting.ai within its category
unknowns: Exact form fields and whether account signup is required
Whether a free listing is dofollow (catalog note says follow; unconfirmed)
